note: See the header of nested-ternaries-linters.cjs. Views: eslint/* from the census pass (Ultracite's options), oxlint/* each rule alone (sonarjs through Oxlint's JS plugins), biome/* each rule alone. unitCounts: trees (or indirect nestings) each view flags in raw mode. perTree: how many reports a flagged tree gets. disagreements: units one view flags and the other doesn't, with the reason from the inventory.

preferTernary.note: External source, raw. One row per reported if statement. form: if-else:<consequent>/<alternate> (single statements), flat-return (`if (a) return x; return y;`), let-plus-if, else-if, if-only. branchHasTernary: a branch (or, for flat-return, the following return) already holds a conditional outside nested functions, so the ternary would contain one (often through an object or call, which no-nested-ternary doesn't report). branchValueIsTernary: the value a branch returns or assigns is itself a conditional, so converting would nest it directly, which no-nested-ternary reports.
